title: 跨仓库存调拨候选
context: 销售＋库存联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 2025年底，每仓每商品库存超过近30日销量两倍且至少多10件为供给；库存低于同期间销量为需求。按商品匹配异仓供需，输出候选调拨量=min(超额,缺口)，仅候选不能同时执行多个配对。
commonError: 候选配对不等于完成调拨优化，同一库存可能被重复分配。
mysqlSql: WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), a AS (SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,COALESCE(s.sold,0) sold FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND p.active=1), b AS (SELECT *,quantity-2*sold surplus,sold-quantity shortage FROM a) SELECT x.product_id,x.warehouse_id from_warehouse,y.warehouse_id to_warehouse,CASE WHEN x.surplus<y.shortage THEN x.surplus ELSE y.shortage END proposed_units FROM b x JOIN b y ON y.product_id=x.product_id AND y.warehouse_id<>x.warehouse_id WHERE x.surplus>=10 AND y.shortage>0 ORDER BY x.product_id,x.warehouse_id,y.warehouse_id
